reference: scan: index-free per-query parallel scan, 256 threads per group, native wave reductions, original active-slot flags
boundaryQueries: 9 fixed centers; uniform-one uses only the central query
boundaryOrder: case index rotated by replicate; arm offset=(replicate+block)%4, forward positions on even replicate+block and reversed on odd
boundaryScope: Host submit-to-readback elapsed for 16 same-input queries, divided by 16; prebuilt index and upload excluded, CPU command recording reported separately; hot repeated input, not pure GPU time or cold working-set evidence
businessOrder: replicate outer, distributions rotated by replicate, arm order rotated by replicate and reversed on odd replicate
occupancyThreshold: background count + 2048 in each zone; the same 4096 obstacles visit zone job%9
consumer: Each sensor update releases nine simulated carts; verified occupancy chooses 350ms direct or 700ms detour route. Carts cannot move before that update's result. CPU oracle is prepared before warmup, not in measured service.
businessScope: Arrival to applied route, first Unity end-of-frame, and transport completion. Same raw input/active uploads for all arms. Scan requires no index; indexed arms rebuild fully. No point-cloud rendering. Identical cart dashboard. One in-flight sensor job; no dropped/coalesced updates.
metrics: query batch host elapsed per repetition
statistics: Process replicate is independent. Boundary median of three blocks; business per-process p95. Pair each indexed arm against scan by seed. Geometric ratios and Student-t 95% CI on five log ratios, df4. Within-process jobs are not independent replicates.
gate: All correctness checks, finite positive measurements, CI excludes 1, both arms CV<=5%, both arms absolute last/first drift<=15%; business additionally zero unfocused workload updates. Otherwise observed or inconclusive, never stable win.
stopRule: Validate nonmultiple size 513, removals, all inactive, last stable ID, zero logical length and alias rejection first. Deliberately corrupt job1 oracle to prove fail-closed route application. One formal attempt per cell; stop on correctness/source mismatch. Retain noise and losses. No parameter search after seeing results.
presentation: No OS presentation or full-frame smoothness claim; Unity end-of-frame is an engine-side milestone. No formal recording, no driver/cache/power changes. Shared R9700 mutex. Existing runtime defaults unchanged.
